clause: Parent item override semantics + primary text frame [STU-LAY-007,STU-LAY-008]

scope.summary: Preserve parent item override semantics exactly: override a single parent item on a document page, override-all parent items on a page, detach an overridden item from its parent (severing the link), remove overrides (restoring inheritance), and a per-item allow-overrides flag that can be disabled so an item cannot be locally altered. Implement the primary text frame on a parent page: a designated text frame that new pages auto-adopt, re-threads automatically when the applied parent changes, and resizes to new page geometry without manual override; primary text frames are the anchor for smart text reflow (MT-154).
acceptance_criteria: exact override semantics incl allow-overrides lock; primary text frame auto-adopts, re-threads, resizes
proof_targets: override lifecycle + allow-overrides lock runtime; primary-frame auto-adopt/re-thread test
expected_tests: live: override-single / override-all / detach / remove-overrides restore inheritance; allow-overrides=false blocks local edit
test: primary text frame auto-adopted by new page + re-threads on parent change + resizes to page geometry

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Overriding parent items & primary text frames

risk_if_missed: Override edits corrupt inheritance; primary text frame missing breaks auto-page reflow anchor.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
